Row 2 (middle row): the MEDIUM bottle, taller body with defined shoulder and long neck, thin silver neck ring and a small blue ribbon. Row 3 (bottom row): the LARGE bottle, tall bulbous ornate body, flared gold base, gold collar and a small blue gem stopper, the most luxurious version. Keep a clean flat elliptical liquid surface with a lighter top edge, glass reflections, and an air gap in the neck; the glass stays transparent and pale ice-blue above the liquid. No label, no tag, no lettering on any bottle. All twelve bottles share exactly the same art style, the same saturated toy-like palette, the same 1px selective dark outline in a darker shade of each object color, flat cel shading with 2-3 tones, crisp hand-placed pixels of the same pixel size everywhere, bright white highlight on the top-left, clean readable silhouette, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no realistic glass refraction, no 3D render, no soft gradient. Match the chunky pixel rendering, glass gloss, cork and selective outline of the reference bottles.
